q_vocab_c1_01_001.question: apa does 'cabe destacar' berarti di academic writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_001.correct: it is worth noting / it should be highlighted
q_vocab_c1_01_001.explanation: 'Cabe destacar' adalah ekspresi akademis formal berarti 'itu patut dicatat' atau 'itu harus disorot'. itu digunakan untuk menarik perhatian pembaca pada poin penting dalam penulisan formal.

q_vocab_c1_01_002.question: apa does 'en lo que respecta a' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_01_002.correct: with regard to / as far as ... is concerned
q_vocab_c1_01_002.explanation: 'En lo que respecta a' berarti 'dengan regard ke' atau 'as far as ... adalah concerned'. itu adalah frasa penghubung formal used untuk memperkenalkan topik atau aspek spesifik dalam wacana akademis.

q_vocab_c1_01_003.question: A modo de ___, podemos afirmar que los resultados confirman la hipótesis inicial.
q_vocab_c1_01_003.explanation: 'A modo de conclusión' berarti 'sebagai conclusion'. ini phrase digunakan di makalah akademis untuk menandakan ringkasan akhir atau komentar penutup dari sebuah argumen.

q_vocab_c1_01_004.question: apa does 'según los datos' berarti di a research context?
q_vocab_c1_01_004.explanation: 'Según los datos' berarti 'according ke ini/itu data'. itu digunakan di penulisan akademis untuk memperkenalkan klaim berbasis bukti didukung oleh temuan empiris.

q_vocab_c1_01_005.question: apa does 'no obstante' berarti di formal writing?
q_vocab_c1_01_005.explanation: 'No obstante' adalah formal connector berarti 'nevertheless' atau 'namun'. itu introduces a contrasting idea dan adalah considered more elevated di register than 'pero' atau 'sin embargo'.

q_vocab_c1_01_006.question: di light dari ini/itu above
q_vocab_c1_01_006.correct: a la luz de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_01_006.explanation: 'di light dari ini/itu above' translates ke 'a la luz de lo anterior' dalam bahasa Spanyol. ini academic phrase refers back ke previously stated evidence atau arguments ke support a new point.

q_vocab_c1_01_007.question: apa does 'dicho de otro modo' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_01_007.explanation: 'Dicho de otro modo' berarti 'di other words' atau 'put differently'. itu digunakan di academic texts ke rephrase atau clarify a complex idea untuk ini/itu reader.

q_vocab_c1_01_008.question: cabe señalar
q_vocab_c1_01_008.explanation: 'Cabe señalar' berarti 'itu seharusnya menjadi pointed out'. Like 'cabe destacar', itu uses ini/itu impersonal kata kerja 'caber' di its sense dari 'ke menjadi fitting' untuk memperkenalkan noteworthy information.

q_vocab_c1_01_009.question: kamu adalah writing a thesis introduction dan need ke present ini/itu scope dari milikmu research. Which expression adalah paling appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_01_009.correct: El presente estudio se centra en analizar los factores que inciden en el fenómeno.
wrong: Este trabajo habla de cosas interesantes.
Voy a escribir sobre un tema que me gusta.
Aquí explico lo que pienso del asunto.
q_vocab_c1_01_009.explanation: 'El presente estudio se centra en' berarti 'ini/itu present study focuses on'. ini adalah standard formal register expected di academic thesis introductions, using precise dan impersonal bahasa.

q_vocab_c1_01_010.question: kamu need ke acknowledge a limitation di milikmu research methodology. Which phrasing demonstrates appropriate academic register?
q_vocab_c1_01_010.correct: Si bien este estudio presenta ciertas limitaciones metodológicas, los hallazgos resultan significativos.
wrong: El estudio tiene problemas pero no importa mucho.
Los errores del estudio no son tan graves como parecen.
Hay fallos pero los resultados son buenos de todas formas.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.explanation: 'Si bien' (meskipun) combined dengan 'limitaciones metodológicas' (methodological limitations) dan 'hallazgos significativos' (significant findings) represents ini/itu balanced, objective tone required di penulisan akademis kapan addressing study limitations.
q_vocab_c1_01_010.context: Writing the limitations section of a research paper

q_vocab_c1_02_001.question: apa does 'la patología' berarti di medical terminology?
q_vocab_c1_02_001.explanation: 'La patología' berarti 'pathology', referring ke ini/itu study dari diseases atau ke a disease kondisi itself. di clinical settings, itu encompasses ini/itu causes, mechanisms, dan effects dari diseases.

q_vocab_c1_02_002.question: El tribunal dictó una ___ absolutoria a favor del acusado.
q_vocab_c1_02_002.explanation: 'Sentencia absolutoria' berarti 'acquittal ruling'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu court issued an acquittal ruling di favor dari ini/itu defendant.' di legal terminology, 'sentencia' mengacu pada a judicial ruling atau verdict.

q_vocab_c1_02_003.question: apa does 'el ensayo clínico' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_02_003.explanation: 'El ensayo clínico' berarti 'clinical trial', a research study conducted ke evaluate ini/itu safety dan efficacy dari medical treatments, drugs, atau devices on human participants.

q_vocab_c1_02_004.question: apa does 'la jurisprudencia' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_02_004.explanation: 'La jurisprudencia' berarti 'jurisprudence' atau 'case law', ini/itu body dari legal principles established through previous court decisions itu guides future judicial rulings.

q_vocab_c1_02_005.question: genome
q_vocab_c1_02_005.explanation: 'Genome' translates ke 'el genoma' dalam bahasa Spanyol. itu mengacu pada ini/itu complete set dari genetic material present di an organism. 'El gen' adalah single gene, sementara 'la genética' adalah field dari genetics.

q_vocab_c1_02_006.question: apa does 'el peritaje' berarti di a legal atau professional context?
q_vocab_c1_02_006.explanation: 'El peritaje' berarti 'expert assessment' atau 'forensic evaluation', a technical report prepared oleh a qualified specialist ('perito') ke provide evidence atau informed opinion di legal atau professional matters.

q_vocab_c1_02_007.question: A research team publishes findings about a new treatment untuk autoimmune diseases. Which term describes ini/itu body's immune system attacking its own cells?
q_vocab_c1_02_007.correct: una enfermedad autoinmune: el sistema inmunitario ataca los tejidos propios del organismo
wrong: una alergia: el cuerpo reacciona a sustancias externas
una infección: bacterias invaden el cuerpo
una intoxicación: el cuerpo absorbe sustancias tóxicas
q_vocab_c1_02_007.explanation: 'Enfermedad autoinmune' berarti 'autoimmune disease'. ini/itu immune system ('sistema inmunitario') mistakenly attacks ini/itu body's own healthy tissues ('tejidos propios'), unlike allergies atau infections which involve external agents.

q_vocab_c1_02_008.question: apa does 'el protocolo' berarti di a scientific atau diplomatic context?
q_vocab_c1_02_008.explanation: 'El protocolo' berarti 'protocol', a formal set dari aturans atau established procedures governing conduct di official, scientific, atau diplomatic settings. di research, itu defines ini/itu methodology dan steps dari an experiment.

q_vocab_c1_02_009.question: la nanotecnología
q_vocab_c1_02_009.explanation: 'La nanotecnología' berarti 'nanotechnology', ini/itu branch dari technology dealing dengan ini/itu manipulation dari matter at an atomic atau molecular scale, typically below 100 nanometers.

q_vocab_c1_02_010.question: A lawyer argues itu a contract clause adalah unenforceable karena one party signed under duress. Which legal concept applies?
q_vocab_c1_02_010.correct: Vicio del consentimiento: la voluntad de una de las partes fue coaccionada.
wrong: Prescripción: el contrato ha expirado por el paso del tiempo.
Novación: el contrato fue sustituido por uno nuevo.
Subrogación: una tercera parte asumió las obligaciones.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.explanation: 'Vicio del consentimiento' berarti 'defect dari consent'. kapan a party signs a contract under 'coacción' (duress), ini/itu agreement bisa voided karena genuine free akan adalah absent. ini adalah fundamental principle di contract law.
q_vocab_c1_02_010.context: Civil court hearing on contract validity

q_vocab_c1_03_001.question: apa adalah ini/itu key difference between 'lograr' dan 'conseguir'?
q_vocab_c1_03_001.correct: 'Lograr' emphasizes achieving a goal through effort; 'conseguir' means to obtain or manage to do something
wrong: They are completely identical in all contexts
'Lograr' means to lose and 'conseguir' means to win
q_vocab_c1_03_001.explanation: sementara both bisa berarti 'ke achieve', 'lograr' carries a stronger connotation dari accomplishment setelah sustained effort (lograr un sueño = achieve a dream), whereas 'conseguir' adalah broader, berarti ke obtain atau manage ke do something (conseguir entradas = get tickets).

q_vocab_c1_03_002.question: apa does 'carecer de' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_03_002.correct: to lack / to be devoid of
q_vocab_c1_03_002.explanation: 'Carecer de' berarti 'ke lack' atau 'ke menjadi devoid dari'. itu adalah formal kata kerja used untuk mengungkapkan ini/itu absence dari something: 'El informe carece de evidencia sólida' (ini/itu report lacks solid evidence).

q_vocab_c1_03_003.question: El candidato ___ un puesto de trabajo acorde con su experiencia profesional.
q_vocab_c1_03_003.explanation: 'Solicitar' berarti 'ke apply untuk' atau 'ke formally request', used di professional dan administrative contexts. 'Pedir' adalah more general dan informal 'ke ask untuk', sementara 'solicitar' implies a formal process seperti job applications atau official requests.

q_vocab_c1_03_004.question: apa adalah ini/itu nuanced difference between 'realizar' dan 'hacer'?
q_vocab_c1_03_004.correct: 'Realizar' implies carrying out something planned or significant; 'hacer' is the general verb for 'to do/make'
wrong: 'Realizar' means to make real and 'hacer' means to destroy
They are exact synonyms with no difference
'Realizar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_03_004.explanation: 'Realizar' suggests executing something dengan deliberation dan importance (realizar una investigación = conduct a study), sementara 'hacer' adalah everyday, semua-purpose kata kerja untuk doing atau making things. Using 'realizar' elevates ini/itu register.

q_vocab_c1_03_005.question: apa does 'matizar' berarti di ini/itu context dari argumentation?
q_vocab_c1_03_005.correct: to qualify / to nuance / to add subtle distinctions
q_vocab_c1_03_005.explanation: 'Matizar' berarti 'ke qualify' atau 'ke add nuance'. di academic atau professional discourse, itu mengacu pada refining a statement oleh adding subtle distinctions atau clarifications, e.g., 'Conviene matizar esta afirmación' (ini statement seharusnya menjadi qualified).

q_vocab_c1_03_006.question: ke undermine / ke weaken
q_vocab_c1_03_006.explanation: 'ke undermine' translates ke 'socavar' dalam bahasa Spanyol. itu berarti ke weaken atau erode something gradually, sering used figuratively: 'socavar la confianza' (ke undermine trust). Do not confuse dengan 'subrayar' (ke underline).

q_vocab_c1_03_007.question: apa adalah ini/itu difference between 'aludir a' dan 'referirse a'?
q_vocab_c1_03_007.correct: 'Aludir a' means to allude to (indirectly); 'referirse a' means to refer to (directly)
wrong: They are identical in meaning and usage
'Aludir a' is more direct than 'referirse a'
'Aludir a' means to hallucinate about something
q_vocab_c1_03_007.explanation: 'Aludir a' implies an indirect atau subtle reference (El autor alude a la guerra sin mencionarla = ini/itu author alludes ke ini/itu war tanpa mentioning itu), sementara 'referirse a' adalah direct dan explicit reference ke something.

q_vocab_c1_03_008.question: prescindir de
q_vocab_c1_03_008.correct: to do without / to dispense with
q_vocab_c1_03_008.explanation: 'Prescindir de' berarti 'ke do tanpa' atau 'ke dispense dengan'. itu expresses deliberately choosing ke omit atau forgo something: 'Podemos prescindir de estos datos' (We bisa do tanpa ini data).

q_vocab_c1_03_009.question: kamu adalah editing a colleague's report dan notice mereka used 'detentar' ke berarti 'ke hold a position legitimately'. adalah ini usage benar?
q_vocab_c1_03_009.correct: No, 'detentar' implies holding power illegitimately; the correct word is 'ostentar' or 'ocupar'.
wrong: Yes, 'detentar' is the only correct verb for holding any position.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.explanation: 'Detentar' specifically berarti ke hold power atau a position illegitimately atau tanpa proper right, sementara 'ostentar' atau 'ocupar' adalah used untuk legitimate office-holding. ini adalah frequently confused pair even among native speakers.
q_vocab_c1_03_009.context: Editing a professional report for publication

q_vocab_c1_03_010.question: A novelist wants ke convey itu a character views ini/itu world dengan excessive optimism itu ignores reality. Which kata kerja best captures ini nuance?
q_vocab_c1_03_010.correct: 'Idealizar': atribuir cualidades de perfección a algo que no las tiene.
wrong: 'Optimizar': mejorar algo para hacerlo más eficiente.
'Visualizar': formar una imagen mental de algo.
'Imaginar': crear algo ficticio en la mente.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.explanation: 'Idealizar' berarti 'ke idealize', attributing unrealistically perfect qualities ke something atau someone. itu implies a distortion dari reality through an overly positive lens, whereas 'imaginar' simply berarti ke envision, dan 'optimizar' berarti ke optimize untuk efficiency.
q_vocab_c1_03_010.context: Literary character analysis in a creative writing workshop

q_vocab_c1_04_001.question: apa does 'Le saluda atentamente' berarti at ini/itu end dari a formal letter?
q_vocab_c1_04_001.explanation: 'Le saluda atentamente' adalah standard formal closing dalam bahasa Spanyol correspondence, equivalent ke 'Yours sincerely' atau 'Yours faithfully'. itu digunakan di business dan official letters.

q_vocab_c1_04_002.question: Me dirijo a usted con el fin de ___ información sobre el programa de becas.
q_vocab_c1_04_002.explanation: 'Solicitar' (ke formally request) adalah appropriate kata kerja di formal correspondence. 'Me dirijo a usted con el fin de solicitar' berarti 'I am writing ke kamu di order ke request'. 'Pedir' akan menjadi juga informal untuk ini register.

q_vocab_c1_04_003.question: apa does 'Estimado/a señor/a' berarti as a formal sapaan?
q_vocab_c1_04_003.explanation: 'Estimado/a señor/a' adalah standard formal salutation dalam bahasa Spanyol letters dan emails, equivalent ke 'Dear Sir/Madam'. 'Estimado' secara harfiah berarti 'esteemed' tetapi functions as ini/itu conventional polite salam.

q_vocab_c1_04_004.question: apa does 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_04_004.correct: I apologize for the inconvenience caused
wrong: I am sorry for the occasion
q_vocab_c1_04_004.explanation: 'Lamento las molestias ocasionadas' adalah formal apology berarti 'I apologize untuk ini/itu inconvenience caused'. Ini adalah commonly used di business correspondence dan customer service communications.

q_vocab_c1_04_005.question: I akan menjadi grateful if kamu bisa
q_vocab_c1_04_005.explanation: 'I akan menjadi grateful if kamu bisa' translates ke 'Le agradecería que' diikuti oleh ini/itu subjungtif mood. ini adalah polite hedging expression used di formal requests, considered more courteous than direct imperatives.

q_vocab_c1_04_006.question: apa does 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_04_006.correct: I remain at your disposal for any clarification
wrong: I am quiet about the situation for now
I stay at the position of clarification
I remain disposed to any clearing
q_vocab_c1_04_006.explanation: 'Quedo a su disposición para cualquier aclaración' adalah formal closing phrase di business correspondence berarti 'I remain at milikmu disposal untuk any clarification'. itu signals willingness ke provide further information.

q_vocab_c1_04_007.question: kamu adalah writing a formal complaint ke a company about defective merchandise. Which opening adalah paling appropriate?
q_vocab_c1_04_007.correct: Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad con el producto recibido.
wrong: Oigan, el producto que me mandaron está roto.
Quiero quejarme porque lo que compré no sirve.
Hola, tengo un problema con algo que pedí.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.explanation: 'Me dirijo a ustedes para expresar mi disconformidad' berarti 'I am writing ke kamu untuk mengungkapkan my dissatisfaction'. ini formal register dengan 'disconformidad' (dissatisfaction) adalah appropriate untuk official complaints, unlike ini/itu informal alternatives.
q_vocab_c1_04_007.context: Formal written complaint to a company

q_vocab_c1_04_008.question: apa does 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_04_008.correct: We kindly ask that you excuse the delay
wrong: We beg for your pardon for the damage
q_vocab_c1_04_008.explanation: 'Rogamos disculpen la demora' uses ini/itu formal 'rogar' (ke request/beseech) dengan subjungtif 'disculpen' ke politely ask forgiveness untuk a delay. 'Rogar' elevates ini/itu register beyond simply 'pedir disculpas'.

q_vocab_c1_04_009.question: sin perjuicio de lo anterior
q_vocab_c1_04_009.correct: without prejudice to the foregoing / notwithstanding the above
q_vocab_c1_04_009.explanation: 'Sin perjuicio de lo anterior' adalah formal legal dan administrative expression berarti 'tanpa prejudice ke ini/itu foregoing' atau 'notwithstanding ini/itu above'. itu digunakan ke state itu a new point does not invalidate previously mentioned terms.

q_vocab_c1_04_010.question: kamu adalah drafting an email ke a government ministry requesting an extension untuk a grant application deadline. Which phrasing demonstrates ini/itu appropriate formal hedging bahasa?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.correct: Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de ampliar el plazo de presentación de solicitudes.
wrong: Necesito más tiempo, así que extienda la fecha.
Quiero que me den más días para entregar todo.
Oiga, no me da tiempo, ¿puede alargar el plazo?
q_vocab_c1_04_010.explanation: 'Tendría a bien considerar la posibilidad de' adalah an extremely formal construction berarti 'akan kamu menjadi so kind as ke consider ini/itu possibility dari'. ini multi-layered hedging (kondisial + polite phrase + possibility) shows ini/itu highest level dari formal register appropriate untuk government correspondence.
q_vocab_c1_04_010.context: Formal correspondence with a government ministry

q_vocab_c1_05_001.question: apa does 'mola' berarti dalam bahasa Spanyol colloquial speech?
q_vocab_c1_05_001.explanation: 'Mola' comes dari kata kerja 'molar', yang merupakan Spanyol slang (primarily di Spain) berarti 'ke menjadi cool' atau 'ke menjadi awesome'. '¡Esa película mola mucho!' berarti 'itu movie adalah really cool!'

q_vocab_c1_05_002.question: apa does 'currar' berarti di informal Spanyol?
q_vocab_c1_05_002.explanation: 'Currar' adalah Spanyol slang berarti 'ke work'. 'El curro' adalah slang kata benda untuk 'work/job'. 'Estoy currando' berarti 'I'm working'. ini adalah sangat umum di everyday speech di Spain.

q_vocab_c1_05_003.question: Se me quedó la mente en ___ durante el examen y no pude responder nada.
q_vocab_c1_05_003.explanation: 'Quedarse en blanco' berarti 'ke go blank' atau 'ke draw a blank'. ini/itu full expression describes ini/itu moment kapan milikmu mind suddenly empties dan Anda bisanot remember anything, especially during stressful situations like exams.

q_vocab_c1_05_004.question: apa does 'flipar' berarti di colloquial Spanyol?
q_vocab_c1_05_004.correct: to be amazed / to freak out / to be shocked
q_vocab_c1_05_004.explanation: 'Flipar' berarti 'ke menjadi amazed' atau 'ke freak out' (di either a positive atau negative sense). '¡Estoy flipando!' bisa berarti 'I bisa't believe itu!' atau 'I'm blown away!' itu originated dari Inggris 'ke flip out'.

q_vocab_c1_05_005.question: apa does 'pasarlo bomba' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_05_005.correct: to have a blast / to have a great time
wrong: to throw a bomb at a party
q_vocab_c1_05_005.explanation: 'Pasarlo bomba' adalah colloquial expression berarti 'ke memiliki a blast' atau 'ke memiliki an amazing waktu'. 'Lo pasamos bomba en la fiesta' berarti 'We had a blast at ini/itu party'. ini/itu 'bomba' metaphorically suggests explosive fun.

q_vocab_c1_05_006.question: ke menjadi fed up / ke menjadi sick dari something
q_vocab_c1_05_006.explanation: 'ke menjadi fed up' translates ke 'estar harto/a'. 'Estoy harto de esperar' berarti 'I'm fed up dengan waiting'. sementara 'lleno' berarti physically full, 'harto' conveys emotional saturation dan frustration.

q_vocab_c1_05_007.question: apa does 'tío/tía' berarti kapan used as slang (not literally)?
q_vocab_c1_05_007.correct: dude / mate / pal (informal way to address someone)
wrong: a rude way to address a stranger
a formal title for elderly people
q_vocab_c1_05_007.explanation: 'Tío/tía' secara harfiah berarti 'uncle/aunt' tetapi di colloquial Spanyol (especially di Spain), itu functions as 'dude', 'mate', atau 'pal'. '¡Eh, tío, ¿qué tal?!' berarti 'Hey dude, bagaimana's itu going?!'

q_vocab_c1_05_008.question: ir de cañas
q_vocab_c1_05_008.correct: to go out for beers / to go bar-hopping for draft beers
wrong: to go to the sugar cane fields
q_vocab_c1_05_008.explanation: 'Ir de cañas' berarti 'ke go out untuk beers', specifically small draft beers ('cañas'). itu adalah quintessential Spanyol social activity involving visiting several bars dan having a small beer at each one.

q_vocab_c1_05_009.question: milikmu Spanyol friend says '¡Qué fuerte!' setelah hearing surprising news. apa register dan arti does ini expression convey?
q_vocab_c1_05_009.correct: It is an informal exclamation expressing shock or disbelief, meaning 'No way!' or 'That's crazy!'
wrong: It is a formal expression meaning the news is physically strong.
It means the news is about someone who is very powerful.
It is a medical term meaning the person feels strong.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.explanation: '¡Qué fuerte!' adalah sangat umum colloquial exclamation di Spain used untuk mengungkapkan surprise, shock, atau disbelief. Secara harfiah berarti 'bagaimana strong!', itu functions like 'No way!' atau 'itu's crazy!' di informal conversation.
q_vocab_c1_05_009.context: Casual conversation reacting to surprising news

q_vocab_c1_05_010.question: A group dari friends adalah planning a Saturday night out. One says: 'Vamos a ir de marcha y lo vamos a pasar genial.' apa does ini berarti dan apa register adalah itu?
q_vocab_c1_05_010.correct: Informal register: 'We're going to go out partying and we're going to have a great time.'
wrong: Formal register: 'We are going on a march and it will be wonderful.'
Neutral register: 'We are leaving on a journey and will arrive safely.'
Military register: 'We are starting a march and will complete it successfully.'
q_vocab_c1_05_010.explanation: 'Ir de marcha' adalah colloquial untuk 'ke go out partying' atau 'ke go out on ini/itu town'. Combined dengan 'pasarlo genial' (ke memiliki a great waktu), ini adalah typical informal youth bahasa di Spain untuk planning a night out.
q_vocab_c1_05_010.context: Friends making weekend plans via group chat

q_vocab_c1_06_001.question: apa does ini/itu proverb 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_06_001.correct: Every cloud has a silver lining
wrong: There is no evil that comes from good
Bad things never happen to good people
No harm comes without a warning
q_vocab_c1_06_001.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' secara harfiah berarti 'di sana adalah no bad itu does not come untuk good'. Ini adalah equivalent ke 'Every cloud memiliki a silver lining', expressing ini/itu idea itu something positive bisa emerge dari negative situations.

q_vocab_c1_06_002.question: Más vale ___ que nunca, así que empecemos el proyecto ahora.
q_vocab_c1_06_002.explanation: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' berarti 'Better late than tidak pernah'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'Better late than tidak pernah, so let's start ini/itu project now.' ini proverb encourages action even kapan delayed.

q_vocab_c1_06_003.question: apa does 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_06_003.correct: The early bird catches the worm / God helps those who rise early
wrong: God helps those who are mature
q_vocab_c1_06_003.explanation: 'A quien madruga, Dios le ayuda' secara harfiah berarti 'God helps those siapa rise early'. kata kerja 'madrugar' berarti 'ke get up early'. Ini adalah equivalent ke ini/itu Inggris proverb 'ini/itu early bird catches ini/itu worm', emphasizing diligence.

q_vocab_c1_06_004.question: apa does 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_06_004.correct: Silence is golden / It's better to keep quiet
wrong: You should close your mouth when flies are near
Insects are attracted to open mouths
q_vocab_c1_06_004.explanation: 'En boca cerrada no entran moscas' secara harfiah berarti 'Flies don't enter a closed mouth'. itu advises discretion dan ini/itu wisdom dari keeping quiet ke avoid trouble, similar ke 'Silence adalah golden'.

q_vocab_c1_06_005.question: don't look a gift horse di ini/itu mouth
q_vocab_c1_06_005.correct: A caballo regalado no le mires el diente
wrong: No mires al caballo en la boca del regalo
El caballo del regalo tiene dientes malos
Regalar un caballo es mirar sus dientes
q_vocab_c1_06_005.explanation: 'A caballo regalado no le mires el diente' adalah exact Spanyol equivalent dari 'Don't look a gift horse di ini/itu mouth'. Both proverbs advise being grateful untuk gifts tanpa criticizing their quality.

q_vocab_c1_06_006.question: apa does 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_06_006.correct: He who grasps at too much loses everything / Jack of all trades, master of none
wrong: Those who hug too much squeeze too little
Big hugs are never tight enough
q_vocab_c1_06_006.explanation: 'Quien mucho abarca, poco aprieta' secara harfiah berarti 'siapa embraces much, squeezes little'. itu warns against taking on juga banyak tasks atau responsibilities at once, as none akan menjadi done well.

q_vocab_c1_06_007.question: A colleague memiliki been complaining about their job tetapi refuses ke look untuk a new one. Which proverb akan menjadi paling fitting advice?
q_vocab_c1_06_007.correct: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' -- You have to take risks to achieve results.
wrong: 'Más vale pájaro en mano que ciento volando' -- Keep what you already have.
'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' -- Ignore the problem.
'Perro ladrador, poco mordedor' -- The complaints are harmless.
q_vocab_c1_06_007.explanation: 'El que no arriesga, no gana' berarti 'Nothing ventured, nothing gained'. itu encourages someone ke take calculated risks rather than remaining di an unsatisfactory situation, yang merupakan appropriate advice untuk someone afraid ke seek change.
q_vocab_c1_06_007.context: Giving career advice to a dissatisfied friend

q_vocab_c1_06_008.question: apa does 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_06_008.correct: You are known by the company you keep / Tell me who your friends are and I'll tell you who you are
wrong: Tell me where you walk and I'll tell you who you are
Walk with me and I'll know your name
Show me your path and I'll show you mine
q_vocab_c1_06_008.explanation: 'Dime con quién andas y te diré quién eres' secara harfiah berarti 'Tell me siapa kamu walk dengan dan I'll tell kamu siapa kamu adalah'. itu emphasizes itu orang adalah judged oleh their associations dan friendships.

q_vocab_c1_06_009.question: Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente
q_vocab_c1_06_009.correct: Out of sight, out of mind
wrong: Eyes that don't see have no feelings
The heart cannot see what the eyes feel
q_vocab_c1_06_009.explanation: 'Ojos que no ven, corazón que no siente' secara harfiah berarti 'Eyes itu don't see, heart itu doesn't feel'. Ini adalah equivalent ke 'Out dari sight, out dari mind', suggesting itu not knowing about something prevents emotional pain.

q_vocab_c1_06_010.question: A student fails an exam tetapi discovers itu ini/itu failure motivated them ke change their study habits, leading ke much better grades. Which proverb perfectly describes ini situation?
q_vocab_c1_06_010.correct: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' -- The setback ultimately led to improvement.
wrong: 'Más vale tarde que nunca' -- They studied late but passed.
'El saber no ocupa lugar' -- Knowledge takes up no space.
'A buen entendedor, pocas palabras bastan' -- Smart students need fewer words.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.explanation: 'No hay mal que por bien no venga' (Every cloud memiliki a silver lining) perfectly describes bagaimana a negative event (failing ini/itu exam) led ke a positive outcome (improved study habits dan better grades). ini/itu proverb captures ini/itu transformative potential dari adversity.
q_vocab_c1_06_010.context: Reflecting on academic setbacks and personal growth

q_vocab_c1_07_001.question: apa does 'el rendimiento' berarti di a business context?
q_vocab_c1_07_001.explanation: 'El rendimiento' di business berarti 'performance', 'yield', atau 'productivity'. 'El rendimiento del equipo' berarti 'team performance', dan 'rendimiento de la inversión' berarti 'return on investment'.

q_vocab_c1_07_002.question: apa does 'el flujo de trabajo' berarti di a professional setting?
wrong: the flow of water at work
q_vocab_c1_07_002.explanation: 'El flujo de trabajo' berarti 'workflow', ini/itu sequence dari processes through which a piece dari work passes dari initiation ke completion. itu adalah standard term di project management dan business operations.

q_vocab_c1_07_003.question: La empresa necesita ___ su modelo de negocio para adaptarse al mercado digital.
q_vocab_c1_07_003.explanation: 'Reestructurar' berarti 'ke restructure', specifically referring ke reorganizing a company's operations, finances, atau strategy. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu company needs ke restructure its business model ke adapt ke ini/itu digital market.'

q_vocab_c1_07_004.question: apa does 'la escalabilidad' berarti di itu dan business?
q_vocab_c1_07_004.explanation: 'La escalabilidad' berarti 'scalability', ini/itu capacity dari a system, network, atau business ke handle growing amounts dari work atau ke expand. itu adalah critical concept di technology startups dan software development.

q_vocab_c1_07_005.question: apa does 'el titular' berarti di journalism?
q_vocab_c1_07_005.explanation: 'El titular' di journalism berarti 'headline', ini/itu title dari a newspaper artikel designed ke capture ini/itu reader's attention. itu bisa juga berarti 'title holder' di other contexts, tetapi di media, itu mengacu pada headlines.

q_vocab_c1_07_006.question: stakeholder
q_vocab_c1_07_006.explanation: 'Stakeholder' translates ke 'la parte interesada' atau 'el interesado' dalam bahasa Spanyol. Unlike 'accionista' (shareholder), a stakeholder adalah any party dengan an interest di atau affected oleh a business atau project.

q_vocab_c1_07_007.question: apa does 'externalizar' berarti di business terminology?
q_vocab_c1_07_007.explanation: 'Externalizar' berarti 'ke outsource', ini/itu practice dari contracting business processes atau functions ke external companies. 'La empresa decidió externalizar el servicio de atención al cliente' berarti 'ini/itu company decided ke outsource customer service'.

q_vocab_c1_07_008.question: la competencia desleal
q_vocab_c1_07_008.explanation: 'La competencia desleal' berarti 'unfair competition', business practices itu adalah deceptive, fraudulent, atau otherwise unfair ke competitors. itu adalah legal concept di commercial law.

q_vocab_c1_07_009.question: A software development team adalah discussing bagaimana ke handle a product launch itu keeps getting delayed. ini/itu project manager suggests adopting a new approach. Which professional term describes ini methodology?
q_vocab_c1_07_009.correct: Implementar una metodología ágil para iterar más rápidamente.
wrong: Cancelar el proyecto y empezar uno nuevo.
Despedir a todos los desarrolladores del equipo.
Ignorar los plazos y lanzar cuando esté listo.
q_vocab_c1_07_009.explanation: 'Metodología ágil' berarti 'agile methodology', an iterative approach ke project management dan software development itu delivers work di small increments. 'Iterar' berarti 'ke iterate', making incremental improvements through repeated cycles.

q_vocab_c1_07_010.question: A journalist needs ke protect ini/itu identity dari a source siapa provided sensitive information about corporate corruption. Which professional principle applies?
q_vocab_c1_07_010.correct: El secreto profesional obliga a proteger la identidad de las fuentes confidenciales.
wrong: La ley obliga a revelar todas las fuentes en cualquier caso.
El periodista debe publicar el nombre completo de la fuente.
Las fuentes anónimas no son válidas en el periodismo.
q_vocab_c1_07_010.explanation: 'El secreto profesional' berarti 'professional secrecy' atau 'source protection'. di journalism, ini ethical principle protects ini/itu identity dari confidential sources ('fuentes confidenciales'), yang merupakan fundamental ke press freedom dan investigative reporting.

q_vocab_c1_08_001.question: apa does 'la trascendencia' berarti di philosophical discourse?
q_vocab_c1_08_001.explanation: 'La trascendencia' berarti 'transcendence' atau 'far-reaching significance'. di philosophy, itu mengacu pada ini/itu aspect dari existence itu goes beyond ini/itu ordinary atau physical realm. di everyday usage, itu berarti lasting importance.

q_vocab_c1_08_002.question: El concepto de ___ ha sido debatido por filósofos durante siglos.
q_vocab_c1_08_002.explanation: 'Identidad' berarti 'identity'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu concept dari identity memiliki been debated oleh philosophers untuk centuries.' Identity adalah core abstract concept di philosophy, psychology, dan sociology.

q_vocab_c1_08_003.question: apa does 'el paradigma' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_08_003.correct: paradigm / model of thought or understanding
q_vocab_c1_08_003.explanation: 'El paradigma' berarti 'paradigm', a framework dari thought, a model dari understanding, atau a set dari accepted beliefs itu defines a field. 'Un cambio de paradigma' (a paradigm shift) mengacu pada a fundamental change di approach atau underlying assumptions.

q_vocab_c1_08_004.question: apa does 'la conciencia' berarti kapan used as an abstract concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_004.explanation: 'La conciencia' as an abstract concept memiliki dual berartis: 'consciousness' (philosophical awareness dari existence) dan 'conscience' (moral awareness). 'Tomar conciencia' berarti 'ke become aware' atau 'ke raise awareness'.

q_vocab_c1_08_005.question: inherent / intrinsic
q_vocab_c1_08_005.explanation: 'Inherent' atau 'intrinsic' translates ke 'intrínseco' dalam bahasa Spanyol. itu describes a quality itu adalah essential dan permanent, belonging naturally ke something: 'el valor intrínseco' (intrinsic value).

q_vocab_c1_08_006.question: apa does 'la equidad' berarti, dan bagaimana does itu differ dari 'la igualdad'?
q_vocab_c1_08_006.correct: equity / fairness; it means providing what each person needs, while 'igualdad' means giving everyone the same
wrong: 'Equidad' means horse riding and 'igualdad' means equality
'Equidad' is an economic term and 'igualdad' is a social one only
q_vocab_c1_08_006.explanation: 'La equidad' berarti 'equity' atau 'fairness', providing resources based on individual needs ke achieve fair outcomes. 'La igualdad' berarti 'equality', treating everyone ini/itu same. ini/itu distinction adalah crucial di social justice discourse.

q_vocab_c1_08_007.question: A philosopher argues itu human freedom adalah inseparable dari responsibility. Which abstract concept adalah central ke ini argument?
q_vocab_c1_08_007.correct: La autonomía: la capacidad del individuo de gobernarse a sí mismo implica asumir las consecuencias de sus actos.
wrong: La dependencia: el ser humano depende de otros para actuar.
La obediencia: la libertad consiste en seguir las reglas establecidas.
La indiferencia: la libertad y la responsabilidad no están relacionadas.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.explanation: 'La autonomía' berarti 'autonomy', ini/itu capacity untuk self-governance. ini/itu philosophical connection between freedom dan responsibility adalah rooted di autonomy: being free ke choose berarti being accountable untuk those choices.
q_vocab_c1_08_007.context: Philosophy seminar on existentialism and ethics

q_vocab_c1_08_008.question: apa does 'la resiliencia' berarti as an abstract psychological concept?
q_vocab_c1_08_008.correct: resilience / the ability to recover from adversity
q_vocab_c1_08_008.explanation: 'La resiliencia' berarti 'resilience', ini/itu psychological capacity ke recover dari difficulties dan adapt ke challenging circumstances. itu memiliki become a central concept di psychology, education, dan personal development.

q_vocab_c1_08_009.question: la alteridad
q_vocab_c1_08_009.correct: otherness / the quality of being different or other
q_vocab_c1_08_009.explanation: 'La alteridad' berarti 'otherness', a philosophical concept itu mengacu pada ini/itu recognition dari ini/itu 'other' as fundamentally different dari oneself. Ini adalah central ke ethics, particularly di ini/itu philosophy dari Emmanuel Levinas.

q_vocab_c1_08_010.question: Two debaters adalah discussing whether morality adalah universal atau culturally determined. Which pair dari abstract concepts frames ini debate?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.correct: El universalismo moral frente al relativismo cultural: ¿existen valores absolutos o dependen del contexto?
wrong: El capitalismo frente al socialismo: ¿quién tiene más dinero?
El optimismo frente al pesimismo: ¿quién es más feliz?
La ciencia frente a la religión: ¿quién tiene la verdad?
q_vocab_c1_08_010.explanation: 'El universalismo moral' (moral universalism) holds itu certain ethical principles apply ke semua humans, sementara 'el relativismo cultural' (cultural relativism) argues itu moral standards adalah shaped oleh culture. ini adalah one dari ini/itu paling fundamental debates di ethics.

q_vocab_c1_09_001.question: apa does 'la metáfora' berarti as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_001.correct: metaphor -- a figure of speech that directly compares two unlike things without using 'like' or 'as'
wrong: a physical transformation of one thing into another
q_vocab_c1_09_001.explanation: 'La metáfora' adalah rhetorical device di which one thing adalah described as being another: 'La vida es un viaje' (Life adalah journey). Unlike a simile, a metaphor does not use 'como' (like/as).

q_vocab_c1_09_002.question: apa does 'la ironía' berarti as a literary device?
q_vocab_c1_09_002.correct: irony -- saying the opposite of what is meant, or a contrast between expectation and reality
q_vocab_c1_09_002.explanation: 'La ironía' encompasses verbal irony (saying ini/itu opposite dari apa kamu berarti), situational irony (kapan ini/itu outcome adalah opposite ke expectations), dan dramatic irony (kapan ini/itu audience knows something ini/itu characters don't).

q_vocab_c1_09_003.question: El orador usó una ___ al decir que había esperado 'un millón de años' para recibir la respuesta.
q_vocab_c1_09_003.explanation: 'Hipérbole' berarti 'hyperbole', a deliberate exaggeration untuk emphasis atau effect. Saying 'a million years' untuk menggambarkan a wait adalah clear contoh dari hyperbole, not meant ke menjadi taken literally.

q_vocab_c1_09_004.question: apa does 'el eufemismo' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_09_004.correct: euphemism -- a mild or indirect expression used to replace one considered too harsh or blunt
q_vocab_c1_09_004.explanation: 'El eufemismo' adalah rhetorical device itu substitutes a mild expression untuk something considered offensive atau unpleasant. Misalnya, 'pasar a mejor vida' (ke pass ke a better life) instead dari 'morir' (ke die).

q_vocab_c1_09_005.question: apa does 'el oxímoron' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_09_005.correct: oxymoron -- a figure of speech combining contradictory terms
wrong: a contradiction that is always an error
a figure of speech using repetition
q_vocab_c1_09_005.explanation: 'El oxímoron' adalah rhetorical device itu places two contradictory terms together untuk effect: 'un silencio ensordecedor' (a deafening silence), 'la oscura claridad' (dark clarity). itu creates striking imagery through paradox.

q_vocab_c1_09_006.question: understatement / deliberate minimization
q_vocab_c1_09_006.explanation: 'Understatement' translates ke 'la litotes' atau 'la atenuación'. Litotes adalah opposite dari hyperbole -- itu deliberately understates something untuk ironic effect. 'No es mala idea' (itu's not a bad idea) kapan berarti 'itu's a great idea' adalah litotes.

q_vocab_c1_09_007.question: apa does 'la antítesis' berarti as a rhetorical device?
q_vocab_c1_09_007.correct: antithesis -- juxtaposing contrasting ideas in a balanced structure
wrong: the answer to a thesis question
a statement that destroys an argument
q_vocab_c1_09_007.explanation: 'La antítesis' places two opposing ideas side oleh side di a parallel structure untuk emphasis: 'Es tan corto el amor y tan largo el olvido' (Love adalah so brief dan forgetting adalah so long) -- Pablo Neruda. itu creates a powerful rhetorical contrast.

q_vocab_c1_09_008.question: la sinécdoque
q_vocab_c1_09_008.correct: synecdoche -- a figure of speech where a part represents the whole, or the whole represents a part
q_vocab_c1_09_008.explanation: 'La sinécdoque' adalah figure dari speech di mana a part stands untuk ini/itu whole atau vice versa. Misalnya, 'Necesitamos más manos' (We need more hands) di mana 'hands' represents workers/orang.

q_vocab_c1_09_009.question: A political speech states: 'We bring not war, tetapi peace; not destruction, tetapi creation; not despair, tetapi hope.' Which rhetorical device adalah primarily being employed?
q_vocab_c1_09_009.correct: La antítesis con anáfora: la repetición de una estructura que contrasta ideas opuestas.
wrong: La hipérbole: una exageración deliberada de los hechos.
El eufemismo: una suavización del lenguaje directo.
La metonimia: la sustitución de un término por otro relacionado.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.explanation: ini/itu speech uses 'antítesis' (antithesis) oleh juxtaposing opposing pairs (war/peace, destruction/creation, despair/hope) dan 'anáfora' (anaphora) through ini/itu repetition dari 'not ... tetapi'. Together, these devices create a powerful rhythmic dan persuasive effect.
q_vocab_c1_09_009.context: Analyzing rhetorical strategies in political discourse

q_vocab_c1_09_010.question: A writer describes a cruel character as 'having a heart dari gold' ke highlight ini/itu gap between appearance dan reality. Which rhetorical device adalah being used?
q_vocab_c1_09_010.correct: La ironía: el escritor dice lo contrario de lo que quiere comunicar para crear un efecto de contraste.
wrong: La metáfora: el escritor describe literalmente que el corazón es de oro.
La hipérbole: el escritor exagera la bondad del personaje.
El eufemismo: el escritor suaviza la crueldad del personaje.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.explanation: ini adalah 'ironía' (irony) karena ini/itu description 'heart dari gold' directly contradicts ini/itu character's actual cruelty. ini/itu reader understands ini/itu intended berarti adalah opposite dari ini/itu literal words, creating a powerful critical effect.
q_vocab_c1_09_010.context: Literary analysis of character portrayal techniques

q_vocab_c1_10_001.question: apa does 'la corrida de toros' refer ke dalam bahasa Spanyol culture?
q_vocab_c1_10_001.explanation: 'La corrida de toros' berarti 'bullfight', a traditional spectacle di Spain involving a matador dan a bull. itu adalah highly controversial cultural practice, celebrated oleh some as art dan criticized oleh others as animal cruelty.

q_vocab_c1_10_002.question: Don Quijote es considerado la primera novela ___ de la literatura occidental.
q_vocab_c1_10_002.explanation: 'Don Quijote de la Mancha' oleh Miguel de Cervantes (1605/1615) adalah widely considered ini/itu first modern novel. itu introduced innovations like metafiction, unreliable narration, dan complex character psychology itu defined modern literature.

q_vocab_c1_10_003.question: apa does 'el flamenco' encompass as a cultural art form?
q_vocab_c1_10_003.correct: a combination of singing (cante), dancing (baile), and guitar playing (toque) originating from Andalusia
wrong: only a type of bird native to Spain
exclusively a musical genre with no dance
a form of bullfighting from Madrid
q_vocab_c1_10_003.explanation: 'El flamenco' adalah comprehensive art form dari Andalusia comprising three elements: 'cante' (singing), 'baile' (dance), dan 'toque' (guitar playing). itu adalah declared UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage di 2010.

q_vocab_c1_10_004.question: apa does 'la siesta' represent culturally di Spain?
q_vocab_c1_10_004.correct: a traditional midday rest or nap, reflecting the adaptation to hot climate and a social rhythm centered on extended lunch
wrong: a type of festival celebrated in summer
a Spanish holiday on the seventh day
q_vocab_c1_10_004.explanation: 'La siesta' adalah brief midday rest traditionally taken setelah lunch. itu reflects Spain's Mediterranean climate adaptation dan a social structure di mana lunch adalah main meal. Though declining di modern urban life, itu remains culturally significant.

q_vocab_c1_10_005.question: ini/itu Camino de Santiago (cultural/historical arti)
q_vocab_c1_10_005.correct: el Camino de Santiago: an ancient pilgrimage route to the Cathedral of Santiago de Compostela
wrong: el Camino de Santiago: a modern highway in northern Spain
el Camino de Santiago: a famous Spanish restaurant chain
el Camino de Santiago: a type of traditional Spanish dance
q_vocab_c1_10_005.explanation: 'El Camino de Santiago' (ini/itu Way dari St. James) adalah one dari ini/itu paling important Christian pilgrimage routes, leading ke ini/itu Cathedral dari Santiago de Compostela di Galicia. itu memiliki been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1993 dan attracts hundreds dari thousands dari pilgrims dan hikers annually.

q_vocab_c1_10_006.question: apa does 'La Tomatina' refer ke?
q_vocab_c1_10_006.correct: an annual tomato-throwing festival held in Buñol, Valencia
wrong: a tomato cooking competition in Barcelona
a tomato harvest celebration across all of Spain
a traditional tomato soup served during Christmas
q_vocab_c1_10_006.explanation: 'La Tomatina' adalah famous festival held annually on ini/itu last Wednesday dari August di Buñol, Valencia. Participants throw tomatoes at each other di apa memiliki become ini/itu world's largest food fight, attracting international visitors.

q_vocab_c1_10_007.question: A tour guide explains ini/itu significance dari 'las tapas' ke foreign visitors. Which description best captures ini/itu cultural arti beyond just food?
q_vocab_c1_10_007.correct: Las tapas represent a social dining culture of sharing small dishes, encouraging conversation and community bonding.
wrong: Tapas are simply appetizers served before the main course.
Tapas are the main meal of the day in Spain.
Tapas are only served in formal restaurants for tourists.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.explanation: 'Las tapas' transcend mere food -- mereka embody a social ritual dari sharing small dishes ('ir de tapas') itu fosters conversation, community, dan leisurely dining. ini/itu practice reflects Spain's emphasis on socializing dan shared experiences over formal, individualized dining.
q_vocab_c1_10_007.context: Cultural tour explaining Spanish social customs

q_vocab_c1_10_008.question: apa does 'el Día de los Muertos' refer ke, dan which country adalah itu paling associated dengan?
q_vocab_c1_10_008.correct: Day of the Dead, a Mexican celebration honoring deceased loved ones on November 1-2
wrong: A Spanish holiday celebrating Halloween on October 31
A religious fast observed in all Latin American countries
A day of mourning observed only in cemeteries
q_vocab_c1_10_008.explanation: 'El Día de los Muertos' (Day dari ini/itu Dead) adalah Mexican tradition (not Spanyol) on November 1-2 di mana families create altars ('ofrendas'), visit cemeteries, dan celebrate ini/itu lives dari deceased loved ones. itu adalah recognized oleh UNESCO di 2008.

q_vocab_c1_10_009.question: Las Fallas de Valencia
q_vocab_c1_10_009.correct: an annual Valencian festival featuring the construction and burning of large artistic sculptures
wrong: a volcanic eruption festival in the Canary Islands
a traditional Valencia orange harvest celebration
a failure commemoration in Valencian history
q_vocab_c1_10_009.explanation: 'Las Fallas' adalah major festival di Valencia celebrated around March 15-19 (Saint Joseph's Day). Neighborhoods build enormous artistic sculptures ('ninots'), which adalah then burned on ini/itu final night ('la cremà'). itu adalah UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage.

q_vocab_c1_10_010.question: A student adalah writing an essay about bagaimana Gabriel García Márquez's 'Cien años de soledad' reflects Latin American cultural identity. Which literary dan cultural concept seharusnya menjadi central ke their analysis?
q_vocab_c1_10_010.correct: El realismo mágico: la fusión de elementos fantásticos con la realidad cotidiana latinoamericana.
wrong: El naturalismo: la descripción científica y objetiva de la realidad.
El romanticismo: la exaltación de los sentimientos individuales europeos.
El existencialismo: la angustia del ser humano ante la libertad.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.explanation: 'El realismo mágico' (magical realism) adalah literary genre di mana magical elements appear naturally within a realistic setting. García Márquez's masterpiece adalah its quintessential contoh, reflecting Latin American cultural identity through mythology, oral tradition, dan ini/itu blending dari ini/itu extraordinary dengan ini/itu everyday.
q_vocab_c1_10_010.context: University literature essay on Latin American cultural identity

q_vocab_c1_11_001.question: apa adalah ini/itu register difference between 'empezar', 'comenzar', dan 'iniciar'?
q_vocab_c1_11_001.correct: 'Empezar' is informal/neutral, 'comenzar' is slightly more formal, and 'iniciar' is the most formal/technical
wrong: All three are identical with no register difference
'Iniciar' is the most informal and 'empezar' is the most formal
'Comenzar' is only used in Latin America
q_vocab_c1_11_001.explanation: These three synonyms untuk 'ke begin/start' vary di register: 'empezar' (everyday), 'comenzar' (slightly elevated, literary), 'iniciar' (formal, technical, administrative). Choosing ini/itu right one demonstrates register awareness at C1 level.

q_vocab_c1_11_002.question: apa adalah ini/itu precise difference between 'efectivo' dan 'eficaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_002.correct: 'Eficaz' means achieving the desired result; 'efectivo' means actually producing a real effect in practice
wrong: They are perfect synonyms with no distinction
'Eficaz' refers to money and 'efectivo' refers to results
'Efectivo' is only used in military contexts
q_vocab_c1_11_002.explanation: 'Eficaz' (efficacious) focuses on ini/itu capacity ke produce ini/itu intended result, sementara 'efectivo' (effective) emphasizes itu something actually works di practice. A treatment bisa 'eficaz' di theory tetapi not 'efectivo' di real-world application.

q_vocab_c1_11_003.question: El gobierno implementó medidas ___ para reducir la contaminación atmosférica.
q_vocab_c1_11_003.explanation: 'Drásticas' berarti 'drastic' (severe dan far-reaching measures). sementara 'dramáticas' (dramatic) dan 'trágicas' (tragic) exist as false friends, 'drástico' specifically mengacu pada extreme measures taken ke solve a problem. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu government implemented drastic measures ke reduce air pollution.'

q_vocab_c1_11_004.question: apa adalah ini/itu difference between 'austero' dan 'sobrio'?
q_vocab_c1_11_004.correct: 'Austero' means strictly simple, avoiding luxury; 'sobrio' means restrained, moderate, and elegant in simplicity
wrong: 'Austero' is positive and 'sobrio' is always negative
q_vocab_c1_11_004.explanation: 'Austero' (austere) implies strictness dan ini/itu deliberate avoidance dari luxury atau comfort: 'una vida austera'. 'Sobrio' (sober/restrained) implies tasteful restraint dan moderation tanpa excess: 'un estilo sobrio'. Both convey simplicity tetapi dengan different connotations.

q_vocab_c1_11_005.question: apa adalah ini/itu advanced antonym dari 'elogiar' (ke praise)?
q_vocab_c1_11_005.explanation: 'Vituperar' dan 'denostar' adalah elevated antonyms dari 'elogiar'. sementara 'criticar' adalah umum-level antonym, 'vituperar' (ke vilify) dan 'denostar' (ke revile/defame) represent ini/itu strongest opposition ke praise, conveying harsh dan public condemnation.

q_vocab_c1_11_006.question: ke worsen / ke deteriorate
q_vocab_c1_11_006.explanation: 'ke worsen' bisa translated as 'empeorar' (general), 'deteriorarse' (gradual decline di kondisi), atau 'agravarse' (becoming more serious, sering medical/crisis). Each memiliki different connotations: 'La situación se agravó' (ini/itu situation worsened -- became critical).

q_vocab_c1_11_007.question: apa adalah ini/itu nuanced difference between 'perspicaz' dan 'sagaz'?
q_vocab_c1_11_007.correct: 'Perspicaz' means perceptive/sharp-sighted (seeing details clearly); 'sagaz' means shrewd/astute (using insight strategically)
q_vocab_c1_11_007.explanation: 'Perspicaz' (perspicacious) emphasizes keen perception dan ini/itu ability ke notice subtle details. 'Sagaz' (sagacious/shrewd) implies using itu perception strategically untuk practical advantage. A detective adalah 'perspicaz' kapan noticing clues dan 'sagaz' kapan connecting them ke solve ini/itu case.

q_vocab_c1_11_008.question: escueto
q_vocab_c1_11_008.explanation: 'Escueto' berarti 'concise', 'terse', atau 'succinct', describing something itu adalah brief dan free dari unnecessary detail. 'Una respuesta escueta' adalah brief, no-frills answer. itu bisa neutral atau slightly negative (implying juga brief).

q_vocab_c1_11_009.question: kamu adalah writing a formal report dan need untuk mengatakan itu a policy 'failed completely.' Which synonym adalah paling appropriate untuk formal register?
q_vocab_c1_11_009.correct: 'La política fracasó rotundamente' -- using 'fracasar rotundamente' for emphatic formal failure.
wrong: 'La política falló totalmente' -- too informal for a report.
'La política fue un desastre completo' -- too colloquial.
'La política no funcionó para nada' -- too conversational.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.explanation: 'Fracasar rotundamente' berarti 'ke fail resoundingly'. di formal writing, 'fracasar' (ke fail) adalah more appropriate than 'fallar' (more mechanical/informal), dan 'rotundamente' (categorically/resoundingly) adalah stronger formal kata keterangan than 'totalmente' atau 'completamente'.
q_vocab_c1_11_009.context: Writing a formal policy evaluation report

q_vocab_c1_11_010.question: A literary critic needs untuk menggambarkan a novel's writing style itu adalah excessively ornate dan over-ini/itu-top. Which pair dari synonyms dan antonyms akan best frame ini critique?
q_vocab_c1_11_010.explanation: 'Recargado' (overloaded/ornate) dan 'ampuloso' (pompous/bombastic) precisely describe an excessively decorated writing style. Their antonyms 'sobrio' (restrained) dan 'escueto' (succinct) represent ini/itu opposite aesthetic. ini vocabulary adalah essential untuk advanced literary criticism.

q_vocab_c1_12_001.question: apa does ini/itu collocation 'tomar una decisión' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_12_001.explanation: 'Tomar una decisión' berarti 'ke make a decision'. dalam bahasa Spanyol, decisions adalah 'taken' (tomar) rather than 'made' (hacer). ini adalah one dari ini/itu paling important collocations ke learn, as 'hacer una decisión' adalah inbenar.

q_vocab_c1_12_002.question: El profesor hizo ___ en la importancia de la participación activa en clase.
q_vocab_c1_12_002.explanation: 'Hacer hincapié en' berarti 'ke emphasize' atau 'ke stress'. ini/itu kalimat berarti 'ini/itu professor emphasized ini/itu importance dari active participation di class.' ini adalah fixed collocation -- 'hincapié' adalah rarely used outside ini expression.

q_vocab_c1_12_003.question: apa does ini/itu collocation 'prestar atención' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_12_003.explanation: 'Prestar atención' berarti 'ke pay attention'. dalam bahasa Spanyol, attention adalah 'lent' (prestar) rather than 'paid'. 'Presta atención a lo que dice el profesor' berarti 'Pay attention ke apa ini/itu teacher says.'

q_vocab_c1_12_004.question: apa does 'correr el riesgo' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_12_004.correct: to run the risk / to take the risk
wrong: to escape the risk by running
q_vocab_c1_12_004.explanation: 'Correr el riesgo' berarti 'ke run ini/itu risk' atau 'ke take ini/itu risk'. 'Si no actúas ahora, corres el riesgo de perder la oportunidad' berarti 'If kamu don't act now, kamu run ini/itu risk dari losing ini/itu opportunity.'

q_vocab_c1_12_005.question: ke file a complaint
q_vocab_c1_12_005.correct: presentar una queja / interponer una reclamación
wrong: poner una queja en un archivo
q_vocab_c1_12_005.explanation: 'ke file a complaint' translates ke 'presentar una queja' (general) atau 'interponer una reclamación' (formal/legal). kata kerja 'interponer' adalah specifically used di legal dan administrative contexts untuk formal claims.

q_vocab_c1_12_006.question: apa does 'dar por sentado' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_12_006.explanation: 'Dar por sentado' berarti 'ke take untuk granted', ke assume something tanpa questioning itu. 'No des por sentado que todos están de acuerdo' berarti 'Don't take untuk granted itu everyone agrees.'

q_vocab_c1_12_007.question: A manager tells an employee: 'Hay que poner en marcha el proyecto antes de fin de mes.' apa does 'poner en marcha' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_12_007.correct: to launch / to set in motion / to get something started
wrong: to put something on a march
q_vocab_c1_12_007.explanation: 'Poner en marcha' berarti 'ke launch', 'ke set di motion', atau 'ke get something started'. itu adalah umum business collocation untuk initiating projects, plans, atau processes. ini/itu manager adalah saying ini/itu project harus launched sebelum ini/itu end dari ini/itu month.

q_vocab_c1_12_008.question: apa does 'llevar a cabo' berarti?
q_vocab_c1_12_008.correct: to carry out / to accomplish / to execute
wrong: to carry to the end of a rope
to bring to a finish line
q_vocab_c1_12_008.explanation: 'Llevar a cabo' berarti 'ke carry out' atau 'ke accomplish'. itu adalah formal collocation used untuk completing tasks, projects, atau plans: 'Llevaron a cabo una investigación exhaustiva' (mereka carried out an exhaustive investigation).

q_vocab_c1_12_009.question: hacer caso omiso de
wrong: to make a house out of something
q_vocab_c1_12_009.explanation: 'Hacer caso omiso de' berarti 'ke disregard' atau 'ke deliberately ignore'. itu implies a conscious choice ke overlook something: 'Hizo caso omiso de las advertencias' (He disregarded ini/itu warnings). Ini adalah more formal than simply 'ignorar'.

q_vocab_c1_12_010.question: A research team presents their findings ke stakeholders. ini/itu lead researcher says: 'Los resultados arrojan luz sobre un fenómeno hasta ahora desconocido.' apa does 'arrojar luz sobre' berarti dan why adalah itu significant?
q_vocab_c1_12_010.correct: 'Arrojar luz sobre' means 'to shed light on' -- it indicates the research has clarified or revealed something previously unknown.
wrong: It means the research literally produced light during an experiment.
It means the results are too bright and need to be dimmed.
It means throwing a spotlight at an audience during a presentation.
q_vocab_c1_12_010.explanation: 'Arrojar luz sobre' (ke shed light on) adalah key academic dan professional collocation berarti ke clarify atau illuminate. Combined dengan 'los resultados arrojan' (ini/itu results shed), itu adalah standard bahasa di research presentations untuk introducing significant findings itu advance understanding.
